rationale: The official MobileNetV2 checkpoint was downloaded from the authorized official PyTorch URL (https://download.pytorch.org/models/mobilenet_v2-b0353104.pth). The official 8-character prefix (b0353104) matched the official filename, and all functional validation checks passed (clean load with weights_only=True, 314 tensors, 0 NaNs, 0 Infs, exact 312 backbone key match into PretrainedInspectionDetector, and statistical pretraining verification). However, the actual full SHA-256 (b03531047ffacf1e2488318dcd2aba1126cde36e3bfe1aa5cb07700aeeee9889) did not match the full 64-character hash specified in the authorization prompt (b0353104d49a37c02b37ba4ef5dd3f3d1b827756f7b9492e73703eb402773cbb). In strict adherence to the Phase 8.10 protocol, the gate is enacted as CHECKPOINT_INTEGRITY_FAILED.
